'''Anj Rujj''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Thugs of Thule/Legends|Thugs of Thule]], a highly educated gang of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a conflict that started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, which includes the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> he frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CL" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' depicts Anj Rujj visiting the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|visited]] the establishment during the events of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Rujj walked past the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Tyyx/Legends|Tyyx]] in the Outlander Club. At the club, he wore a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[shirt]], yellow [[Clothing/Legends|pants]], a yellow [[Scarf/Legends|scarf]], and a pair of red shoes. Rujj had light skin and blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]] kept in a braid.<ref name="CL" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Anj Rujj was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', authored by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The Outlander Club content in the book, which includes Rujj, was illustrated by [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Artist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hansjenssen.co.uk/star-wars-locations|text=''Star Wars Locations''|author=[[Hans Jenssen]]|archivedate=20190517022701}}</ref>
